name: PdxButton
description: A button over the Pragmatic CSS button styles, with variants, sizes and a loading state.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: full
members.description: Stretches to the full width of its container.

members.name: label
members.description: The button's text, rendered inside its `<button>` after any slotted content (an icon). Set this — not `textContent`, which replaces the rendered `<button>` with bare text once the button is connected.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: The accessible name of an icon-only button, forwarded to the inner `<button>`: `aria-label` on the host has no role to name.

members.name: ariaLabelledby
members.description: The id of an element whose text names the button, forwarded to the inner `<button>`.

members.name: action
members.description: A write the button runs: anything with `execute(arg?)` and `pending()` — a `mutation()`. A click calls `execute(actionArg)`; while `pending()` the button shows loading, and refuses clicks unless the action's `concurrency` is `'coalesce'` or `'parallel'`, so a double click sends one write.

members.name: actionArg
members.description: The value a click passes to `action.execute`.

members.name: size
members.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl — the same scale as pdx-input and pdx-select.

events.name: pdx-action-error
events.description:
When the `action`'s `execute` rejects. The error is the one
the action keeps on its `error()`; the button is idle again.

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description:
`loading` is set, or the `action` is pending: the button shows a spinner and is
`aria-busy`.
